name: Helen Adcock
story: Helen Adcock demonstrated DOC’s WERI wetlands database in 1990 and co-authored its National Database Workshop report.
Helen Adcock demonstrated DOC’s WERI wetlands database at its March 1990 National Database Workshop. Conservancies would update their own records and return copies for the national dataset.

sources.label: Helen M. Adcock and W. Mary McEwen, DOC National Database Workshop report, October 1990, printed pp.27–28
